name: The Owl House: The Chronicles of Sir William
source:
A fan-made visual novel series for The Owl House animated TV show, beginning in the middle of Season 2 and continuing to an alternate ending.

In her search for lore on glyph magic, Luz awakens a mystical knight, Sir William, from fifty years of slumber. Together, they will delve into the sordid past of The Boiling Isles, confront the tyrannical regime of Emperor Belos, and become sidetracked by all sorts of magical misadventures.

[From [url=https://scribertron.itch.io/the-owl-house-the-chronicles-of-sir-william]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
粉丝为猫头鹰之家动画电视节目制作的视觉小说系列，从第二季中间开始，一直到另一个结局。

在寻找符文魔法知识的过程中，卢兹从五十年的沉睡中唤醒了一位神秘的骑士威廉爵士。他们将一起深入探索沸腾群岛的肮脏过去，对抗贝洛斯皇帝的残暴政权，并因各种神奇的不幸遭遇而偏离轨道。

[来自[url=https://scribertron.itch.io/the-owl-house-the-chronicles-of-sir-william]itch.io[/url]]
